original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-category-summands-finite-free}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Set $R = \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$. The category of
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules which are summands of finite free
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules is equivalent to the category of
finite projective $R$-modules.

Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.

$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules which are summands of finite free
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules is equivalent to the category of
finite projective $R$-modules.
hypotheses: $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is a ringed space; put $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$.
conclusions: The category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules that are direct summands of finite free $\mathcal O_X$-modules is equivalent to the category of finite projective $R$-modules.
semantic_review_note: For a ringed space X with R=Γ(X,O_X), the category of O_X-modules that are direct summands of finite FREE O_X-modules is equivalent to finite projective R-modules. The final preserves global finite-free summand rather than locally free sheaves, which need not all descend to R.
